title: Yesterday, i felt loved not only by GOD but also by families and thousands of friends that greeted me and wish me well on my birthday!
paragraphs: Yesterday, i felt loved not only by GOD but also by families and thousands of friends that  greeted me and wish me well on my birthday!
Last year was full of challenges and suffering, but it was all a test and a process to make me mature and mold me to be a better version of me.

i thank God for always there for me, and to my wife Asis Pinky who stick with me even in my lowest moment of my life,  and especially to all my families and friends who never abandoned me... thank you so much.

GOD is faithful to His promises. when you will be awakened to the what really is your purpose, God will continue to aligned you and mold you to be the person He wants you to be... then GOD will assign you to where He wants you to be.... Thank you God for using some people to be your instrument to align me, i thank you for the life of Pastor Rey Sanico  and Pastora Cecile Sanico  that you used to pull me back towards you and helped in molding who i am today. Thank you God for your vision, truly you are faithful and used people  so i can fulfill my assignments towards your kingdom. Thank you for the people that you used... and thank you for all the friends that continue to support me. Trully, You ARE AN AMAZING AND FAITHFUL GOD.!
